done_when: forge doctor and forge upgrade print one suggested fast_test line for the repo's test kind: Python repos get forge test --pytest {base}; vitest or jest repos get their runner on changed files with --passWithNoTests using the repo's own install and runner; mixed repos get one part per kind; Go, Rust, Java, .NET and Ruby repos get no line; skill.md says so; new and existing client repos each have a command test

findings.body: The previously reported case remains: `uv run pytest && npm ci && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint . && npm test`, with npm test running Vitest or Jest. Direct ESLint is classified as an unknown command, so the Python picker retains it while removing npm installation and the Node runner at src/forge/fasttest.py:120–121. When Python tests are selected or shared inputs change, the retained pipeline executes at src/forge/fasttest.py:171, running ESLint before npm ci. Both doctor and upgrade therefore suggest a command that fails without installed Node dependencies or runs ESLint twice when they exist. Classify direct local Node checks consistently so they execute once after installation. This is the direct-executable evidence beyond the coordinator’s isolation ruling.
findings.title: Keep installation before direct Node checks in mixed suggestions

findings.body: The previously reported trailing-option case remains: `npm exec jest --workspace=web` becomes `npm exec -- jest --workspace=web --changedSince {base} --passWithNoTests`. Inserting the separator before the runner converts npm’s workspace selection into a runner argument, losing the intended execution context. Vitest suggestions have the same problem, through both doctor and upgrade. Preserve npm configuration options before the inserted separator. [npm’s exec contract](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-exec/#npx-vs-npm-exec) confirms that npm parses options following positional arguments until `--`; this is the trailing-option evidence beyond the earlier leading-option repair.
findings.title: Preserve trailing npm options when inserting the exec separator

why: Repos without a quick test setting don't learn which quick test command fits them
